from pocket_coffea.lib.processor import Processor
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import semileptonic_selection
import awkward as ak

class DimuonAnalyzer(Processor):
    def object_preselection(self, df, dataset):
        """Build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = df.Muon
        good_muons = muons[
            (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        df["MuonGood"] = good_muons
        return df

    def object_counting(self, df, dataset):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        df["n_muons"] = ak.num(df.MuonGood)
        return df
